name: GitHub Sync
description: Automatically exports your Bludit articles to a GitHub repository as Markdown files with YAML frontmatter, keeping a versioned backup of your content in sync on every save.

features.0: Pushes every article create, update and delete to GitHub via the GitHub API
features.1: Exports Markdown with YAML frontmatter (title, date, slug, tags)
features.2: Separate toggles for auto-exporting drafts and published articles
features.3: Bulk export of all articles or published articles only
features.4: Uploads referenced images and links them with relative paths
features.5: Reports errors in the settings panel without breaking saving
